title: Normalized clopen scalar witnesses for arbitrary prescribed presentations
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $j_i:Y_i\hookrightarrow X$ a finite pairwise disjoint open and closed cover [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion], with small pro-etale module categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Prescribe arbitrary families $p,q_i$ of presentations of the existing universal left derived scalar extension functors, with normalizations $N,N_i$ [def-pur-clopen-derived-scalar-comparison-data]. Then there are normalized unit comparison structures $U,V_i$ for these same prescribed presentations and a scalar/restriction comparison $d_i$ for each component. Each $d_i$ has the section formula, the degreewise chain formula, the cochain K-flat representative formula, and the full compositor and identity coherence of the comparison-data definition. The underlying ordinary and derived extension functors are those of $p,q_i$. This statement assembles witnesses in the cochain localization model and does not assert the conversion to homotopy representatives.

lean.statement:
theorem clopen_arbitrary_scalar_normalized_witnesses
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (I : Type w) [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{t})
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i)]
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i k ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (j i)) (Set.range (j k))))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (j i))
    (p : Presentations.{t, u} X) (N : Normalization (J := topology X) p)
    (q : ∀ i, Presentations.{t, u} (Y i))
    (Ni : ∀ i, Normalization (J := topology (Y i)) (q i)) :
    ∃ (U : Units p) (V : ∀ i, Units (q i))
      (d : ∀ i, Comparison (j i) p (q i)),
      ∀ i, (d i).sections ∧ (d i).degree ∧ (d i).representative ∧
        Coherence (j i) N (Ni i) U (V i) (d i)
